title: UTM Tape Executable Witness
construction: Tape cell n carries (gap_symbol(n), hole_symbol(n mod 6)). The two gap symbols give the binary tape alphabet; the six hole symbols give a finite parity/gauge track tied to the K12/F12 face code.
verdict: This closes the Holonet paper's tape-alphabet witness: it gives an executable symbolic tape stream from BC gaps plus six genus-hole parity symbols. It does not prove a full universal transition table for a specific Turing machine.
boundary: Tape alphabet witness only; full UTM dynamics requires a transition-rule compiler.
